descriptor: Developer documentation with a sense of humour

voice.summary: Pathfinder Docs apologises for the missing page with a grin, then immediately points to the right ones. The tone is a helpful senior engineer who still remembers being lost in the docs.
dos: Admit the page is missing in the first line
Offer three useful links before the joke ends
donts: Do not blame the reader for a broken link
Avoid long gags that delay the way back
Never hide the home link behind the game

taglines: Back to the docs in one jump
boilerplate: Pathfinder Docs is the documentation site for a developer toolkit, built to keep readers moving even when a page has gone missing.

microcopy.error: The game hit a bug. Try refreshing.
microcopy.empty: No score yet. Press space to start.

logo.note: A paper plane matches the little runner in the game and the idea of finding your way.
